supersedes_for_future_versions_only: BBO-only quote evidence in v3; v3 artifact and gate remain immutable

contract.decision_time: paper tick start / actual simulated execution time, evaluated independently at both instants
contract.availability: frame must have been archived by the decision instant; source receipt must be at or before that instant; measure receipt-to-archive and archive-to-decision separately
contract.connection: frame connection_id must equal the currently healthy collector connection; any reconnect or missing continuity invalidates until a new frame is received on the current connection
contract.l2Book: use the actual top bid/ask price and size from levels[0][0] and levels[1][0]; it may stand as current quote evidence only while itself <=1000 ms old; matching an older BBO can confirm equality at l2 receipt time but does not extend freshness beyond the l2 source-age bound
contract.heartbeat: health/heartbeat is a connection-liveness signal only and never refreshes quote or book age
contract.fallback: if no admissible BBO or l2Book exists, quote status is unknown/stale and execution is rejected; do not carry forward levels or infer unchanged state

historical_gate_effect: none; existing failed v3 gate remains failed and v3 is not modified
decision: Do not start v3 from the stopped stale retry. Any future launch requires a separately versioned proposal decision and its own bounded gate; no repeated windows are authorized by this artifact.
